# DBML Converter

> DBML Converter is a browser-based tool that converts DBML schemas into JSON, Prisma schemas, and TypeORM entities, with diagnostics and an interactive ER diagram.

DBML is parsed into a shared JSON representation before the Prisma and TypeORM outputs are generated. Conversion diagnostics describe invalid or potentially unsupported input, and some diagnostics provide optional repair actions.

Important notes:

- Schema conversion runs in the browser.
- Generated output should be reviewed before use in production.
- Split View is intended for quick conversion and comparison.
- Files View organizes generated output as individual files.
- ER Diagram provides a visual, draggable representation of tables and relationships.

## Application

- [DBML Converter](https://alexbgh1.github.io/dbml-converter/): Project overview and entry point.
- [Split View](https://alexbgh1.github.io/dbml-converter/split-view): Edit DBML and compare generated outputs.
- [Files View](https://alexbgh1.github.io/dbml-converter/files-view): Browse and download generated files.
- [ER Diagram](https://alexbgh1.github.io/dbml-converter/diagram): Visualize tables, columns, keys, and relationships.

## Project

- [Source repository](https://github.com/alexbgh1/dbml-converter): Application source code, README, and development history.
